name.description: The name of the service, which names its directory and, with the scope of the root package.json's name, its package

directory.description: The directory the service is created under (e.g., 'apps' or 'apps/internal')

projectName.description: The project's name, as tasks address it. Defaults to the service's name.

tags.description: The tags the module boundaries read (e.g., 'type:app,scope:internal')
